source_review.finding: RELEASE_ENVELOPE_UNPROVEN is logged only. Preparation notifications are limited to DIRECT_CLOUD_PREPARING and DIRECT_CLOUD_FAILED.
The no-next-source message is a five-second notification gated on confirmed natural end, current ownership and no cancellation. It does not open a source picker or episode list.
Cinema continuity skips the legacy PlayNext dialog.
The next button uses PlayerControl(Next); it is not a next-episode source-selection recovery entry.
Non-natural terminal reasons cancel the current selection unless a matching explicit manual-next grant exists. Cancelled selections fail owned_state, so the natural-end toast does not cover them.
